autoReset.title: Automatic reset card settings
autoReset.description: With auto-switch enabled, use cards only when every backup account has no quota left. For accounts with two quota windows, both must be exhausted. Prefer accounts with earlier-expiring cards.
autoReset.concurrentHint: Defaults to 1. Use one card per exhausted account, up to this limit.
autoReset.singleHint: Outside concurrent mode, use at most 1 card per batch. This limit applies to concurrent mode.
autoReset.reserveHint: Use a card only when the available count exceeds this reserve. Set to 0 to keep no reserve.
autoReset.accounts: Accounts allowed to use reset cards
autoReset.accountHint: Accounts must participate in auto-switch. Concurrent mode also respects the selected account group.
autoReset.noneSelected: No accounts selected. No cards will be used automatically.
autoReset.loadError: Could not load settings. Please retry.
autoReset.saveError: Could not save settings. Check that the selected accounts are still available and retry.

accountsOnly.description: Your Codex accounts, together. Switch and get started.
accountsOnly.loginDescription: Manage only accounts you are authorized to use, locally.
accountsOnly.browserDescription: Authorize in your system browser. Passwords and verification codes are not saved.
accountsOnly.importDescription: Import your own Codex auth.json. It stays on this computer.
accountsOnly.closeCodex: Could not switch accounts. Please retry.
accountsOnly.credentialStore: Your credential storage or workspace policy does not allow file switching. Sign in through Codex.
accountsOnly.switchFailed: Could not switch accounts. Check your credential file and try again.
accountsOnly.cloudConsent: I agree to sync account credentials to the specified server.
accountsOnly.cloudDescription: Sync accounts and credentials, without passwords, verification codes, or chats. Switching remains manual on this computer.
accountsOnly.health.availableHint: Verified in the last 15 minutes. Actual access is determined by Codex.
accountsOnly.health.uncheckedHint: No recent result. Use the shield button to check this account.
accountsOnly.health.refreshNeededHint: The access token is expiring. Check to try a refresh, or authorize again.
accountsOnly.health.needsLoginHint: Credentials are incomplete or authorization was rejected. Sign in again.
accountsOnly.health.checkFailedHint: The check could not finish. A network error does not mean the account is invalid.
accountsOnly.health.restrictedHint: The service denied access. Check account or workspace permissions.
accountsOnly.health.rateLimitedHint: The service is limiting requests. Try again later.
accountsOnly.health.reauthorizeHint: Authorize as {email}. Signing in as another account saves it separately without replacing this account.
accountsOnly.health.loadFailed: Account status could not be loaded. Try again later.
accountsOnly.health.busy: Another account operation is running. Try again shortly.
accountsOnly.continuity: Switch accounts, keep local chats and context
accountsOnly.continuityHint: Uses the same Codex data directory without rewriting chats. Cloud chats and workspace permissions do not transfer.
accountsOnly.automation.title: Automation
accountsOnly.automation.saveFailed: Settings were not saved. Check the selected accounts and goal.
accountsOnly.preheat.title: Greet after quota recovery
accountsOnly.preheat.description: Schedule greetings from the server quota reset time and verify available quota before sending.
accountsOnly.preheat.safety: Uses a separate temporary chat, once per window. An uncertain result pauses sending; toggle the account off and on to retry.
accountsOnly.relay.title: Goal handover
accountsOnly.relay.description: When the selected goal runs out of account quota, switch to an available account and continue the same chat and goal.
accountsOnly.relay.loadFailed: Could not read goals. Check that Codex Home matches the official app.
accountsOnly.relay.noGoals: Create a goal in Codex, then refresh this list
accountsOnly.relay.safety: On quota exhaustion, switch directly and reopen the original chat without exit or save prompts. Other running Codex tasks are interrupted. Goal budgets, approvals and manual pauses remain unchanged.
accountsOnly.automation.status.waitingAc: Waiting for an account to recover

accountsOnly.antigravity.empty: Add a signed-in Antigravity account to get started.
accountsOnly.antigravity.loginHint: Sign in in the official app, then return here to add the signed-in account.
accountsOnly.antigravity.addHint: Use official sign-in. Credentials stay in your local system credential store.
accountsOnly.antigravity.noCurrent: No signed-in account detected. Sign in to Antigravity first.
accountsOnly.antigravity.removeHint: Remove this saved account without signing out of Antigravity.
accountsOnly.antigravity.waitingLogin: Finish signing in in your browser. This can take up to 3 minutes.
accountsOnly.antigravity.cacheHint: Only the current account refreshes. Other accounts show saved values. Switching restarts Antigravity immediately.
accountsOnly.antigravity.widgetHint: Leave empty for all models; scroll to see more.

accountsOnly.antigravity.error.storage: Account records could not be saved. Try again.

accountsOnly.antigravity.error.switch: Account switching did not finish. Check Antigravity and retry.
accountsOnly.tokens.title: Token history
accountsOnly.tokens.coverage: Native sessions retained in this Codex directory only, excluding manager proxy statistics. Server-side and deleted history cannot be recovered. Records without explicit account identity remain unattributed. Cached input is included in input; reasoning is included in output.
accountsOnly.tokens.partial: Some files could not be read. Check file permissions.
accountsOnly.import.summary: Added {added}, merged {merged}, skipped {skipped}. Existing notes and settings were preserved.
accountsOnly.import.mergedLogin: Login credentials merged into the existing account. Notes and settings were preserved.

accountsOnly.recovery.stepWaiting: Waiting {seconds}s; check the sign-in window for required actions
accountsOnly.recovery.progressUnavailabl: Sign-in progress is unavailable; authorization is still running.
accountsOnly.folderSync.title: Cloud folder sync
accountsOnly.folderSync.description: Interlude encrypts account backups. Your cloud client uploads and downloads them; no extra server login is needed.
accountsOnly.folderSync.desktopOnly: Configure sync in the desktop app. Browser preview cannot access local files.
accountsOnly.folderSync.guide.nutstore: Enable folder sync in Nutstore, then choose that folder. Download its files locally on a new computer.
accountsOnly.folderSync.guide.onedrive: Choose a OneDrive folder kept on this device rather than online-only placeholders.
accountsOnly.folderSync.guide.other: Configure sync or backup in your cloud client first. A download folder does not upload automatically. For one-way backup, download files before restoring on a new computer.
accountsOnly.folderSync.keySaved: Stored on this device; leave blank to keep
accountsOnly.folderSync.keyPlaceholder: Enter your original 64-character key or generate one
accountsOnly.folderSync.keyCopied: Key copied. Keep a separate safe copy.
accountsOnly.folderSync.keyHint: The key stays in the OS credential store, outside the cloud folder. Keep it for reinstalling or changing computers; lost keys cannot be recovered. Complete backups include saved passwords and authenticator secrets, but not chats.
accountsOnly.folderSync.keyAcknowledged: I saved the key in another safe place
accountsOnly.folderSync.autoHint: Checks every two minutes and writes only changes; keeps five versions per device. Runs after closing the main window, stops on full exit.
accountsOnly.folderSync.transferHint: Local status does not confirm cloud upload. On a new or reinstalled computer, download the Interlude folder, select it and enter the original key. Disconnecting keeps backups.
accountsOnly.folderSync.restoreHint: Backs up local data first, then merges by modification time. Does not switch the active account or propagate account deletions.
accountsOnly.folderSync.backedUp: Backup checked; changes written to the local sync folder.
accountsOnly.folderSync.nothing: No local accounts to back up.
accountsOnly.folderSync.error.io: Cannot read or write backups. Check permissions and retry.
accountsOnly.folderSync.error.folder: Sync folder unavailable. Check the disk and local cloud files.
accountsOnly.folderSync.error.format: Invalid or incomplete backup. Wait for the cloud download to finish.
accountsOnly.folderSync.error.key: Invalid recovery key or it does not match this folder.
accountsOnly.folderSync.error.keyStore: OS credential store unavailable; the recovery key cannot be saved safely.
accountsOnly.folderSync.error.busy: An account or backup operation is active. Retry shortly.
accountsOnly.folderSync.error.missing: Backup file not available locally. Finish downloading it first.
accountsOnly.backup.title: Backup and restore
accountsOnly.backup.description: One encrypted file and one backup password. Save it on a USB drive, external disk or local folder and restore on another computer.
accountsOnly.backup.includes: Includes account tokens, notes, saved login passwords, original authenticator secrets and auto-login configuration. Unsaved information cannot be recovered; temporary six-digit codes are not authenticator secrets.
accountsOnly.backup.passwordHint: At least 12 characters; use a long passphrase
accountsOnly.backup.keepPassword: This is a separate backup password, not your account password. The app does not store it and cannot recover it. Keep it separate from the backup file.
accountsOnly.backup.restoreHint: First encrypts a safety copy of local data, then merges accounts, passwords and authenticator settings. Newer local settings are preserved; the active account is not switched.
accountsOnly.backup.exported: Backed up {accounts} accounts and {logins} auto-login entries.
accountsOnly.backup.restored: Processed {accounts} accounts; the backup contains {logins} auto-login entries.
accountsOnly.backup.safetyBackup: Pre-restore local backup: {path}. Decrypt it with the password you just entered.
accountsOnly.backup.desktopOnly: Offline backup is available in the desktop app only.
accountsOnly.backup.passwordError: The backup password must contain at least 12 characters.
accountsOnly.backup.decryptError: Incorrect password or damaged backup. No recovery data has been written.
accountsOnly.backup.fileError: Cannot read or write the backup. Check the file, free space and folder permissions.
accountsOnly.backup.emptyError: No accounts to back up. Add an account first.
accountsOnly.backup.vaultError: The OS credential store could not be fully read or written. Unlock it and retry.
accountsOnly.backup.rollbackError: Login-setting rollback failed; recovery is incomplete. Keep the pre-restore backup and check the OS credential store.
accountsOnly.backup.busyError: An account switch or backup is in progress. Retry shortly.
accountsOnly.folderSync.error.vault: The OS credential store could not be fully read or written. Unlock it and retry.
accountsOnly.folderSync.error.rollback: Login-setting rollback failed; recovery is incomplete. Keep the pre-restore backup and check the OS credential store.
